exam.title: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist
exam.study_prerequisites: Must previously have passed CKA; the current official policy says CKA need not remain active. Practice v1.35 cluster/setup/system hardening; RBAC, ServiceAccounts and API exposure; Pod Security, Secrets, sandboxing and mTLS; SBOM/provenance/signing/admission/scanning; audit/runtime detection, investigation, immutability and recovery. Verify the live version and weights because v1.37 is in the provider's 4–8-week watch window and the CNCF overview retains older weights while the v1.34-named PDF matches the current Linux Foundation outline.

review.notes: All six live Linux Foundation Kubernetes v1.35 domains are mapped through prevention, detection, response and recovery, with three defensive scenarios, eight authorized labs and 42 original checks. All 11 guide URLs are cataloged: nine reachable and O'Reilly plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The live 15/15/10 weights, lagging CNCF 10/15/15 overview/v1.34 PDF and previously-passed-but-not-active CKA policy are explicit. The August 26 v1.37 release creates a bounded September 23–October 21 recheck window without overriding v1.35, and the retired community ingress-nginx controller is distinguished from the stable Ingress API and current objective. No offensive target instructions, proprietary simulator tasks, course labs or recalled exam tasks are used. September 17, 2026 public delivery-page maintenance: corrected the listed simulator question range to 20–25, explicitly separated from live exam item counts. Historical objective and full-review dates are unchanged.

findings.title: Older PDF filename does not mean older objective weights
findings.evidence: Actual three-page v1.34-named PDF lists current 15/15/10/20/20/20 weights and 26 competencies, while CNCF overview retains older first-three weights.
findings.recommendation: Clarify discrepancy and retain Linux Foundation canonical scope; do not overwrite baselines.
findings.resolution: Clarify discrepancy and retain Linux Foundation canonical scope; do not overwrite baselines.

findings.title: Current simulator count differs from guide metadata
findings.evidence: Current page lists17questions per simulator activation; guide inherited20–25datedSeptember17. No concrete exam-version switch date is announced.
findings.recommendation: Update simulator-only number and date; replace unsupported scheduled flag with none-announced while keeping approximate watch.
findings.resolution: Update simulator-only number and date; replace unsupported scheduled flag with none-announced while keeping approximate watch.

findings.title: A signature check does not establish signer identity or deployment policy
findings.evidence: Detached signature verification validates signed bytes against a supplied key, not its publisher identity or all related claims.
findings.recommendation: Execute original real positive/negative checks plus signed claim/digest/release approval conditions with explicit trust limits.
findings.resolution: Execute original real positive/negative checks plus signed claim/digest/release approval conditions with explicit trust limits.

findings.title: Audit rules are first-match and omitted stages are combined
findings.evidence: A broad earlier body-logging rule can bypass later SecretMetadata intent; no matching rule means noevent.
findings.recommendation: Add exact restricted model and12checks; distinguish prediction from actual auditing/backendverification.
findings.resolution: Add exact restricted model and12checks; distinguish prediction from actual auditing/backendverification.

findings.title: Workload admission and Pod security enforcement are different checks
findings.evidence: Enforce applies to resultingPods; audit/warn also evaluate workloadtemplates and exemptions skipallmodes.
findings.recommendation: Explain existingDeployment/deniedPods and strengthen liveevidence requirements.
findings.resolution: Explain existingDeployment/deniedPods and strengthen liveevidence requirements.

findings.title: Omitted seccomp fields do not prove runtime-default enforcement
findings.evidence: Effective default depends on kubeletseccompDefault; APIfieldsneednotchange andprivilegedcontainersrunUnconfined.

findings.title: API creation does not prove requested AppArmor profile runs
findings.evidence: A missing explicitprofile can cause kubeletrefusal after APIobjectcreation.
findings.recommendation: Correct profilecoverage answer and add pernode/replacement verification.
findings.resolution: Correct profilecoverage answer and add pernode/replacement verification.

findings.title: New encryption configuration does not migrate all old records
findings.recommendation: Add controlledmigration/backupboundary with no actualstorage or globalrewrite operation.
findings.resolution: Add controlledmigration/backupboundary with no actualstorage or globalrewrite operation.

findings.title: Ignore handles call failures rather than overriding explicit denial
findings.evidence: failurePolicy controls errors/timeouts; admissionresponse allowedfalse is a policyrejection.

findings.title: Encryption coverage depends on traffic path and mode
findings.recommendation: Add proposedcoverage matrix andqualifyinstalledversion; no networkconfigurationorpacket capture.
findings.resolution: Add proposedcoverage matrix andqualifyinstalledversion; no networkconfigurationorpacket capture.
